messages:
Marta (mktg): Heads-up: were finalizing the announcement for Optimize v2 tomorrow. Need engineering to confirm changelog lines, docs URLs, and a rollout schedule. Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/433 . Docs preview: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2-preview . Can we lock timing by EOD PT?

Sam (eng): I'll review now. Proposal: dry-run canary at 09:30 PT (5% traffic), demo pin for webinar at 10:00 PT, promote to 100% around 12:00 PT if green. Small shim fix to KV cache logic will be merged before canary.

Emily (docs): I updated the quickstart and added the example CLI output. Need the Console screenshot with the new latency table. Can get that by 15:30 PT and then push final URL. Also suggest a short faq blurb about rolling back.

Jamal (pm): Webinar at 10:15 PT. We must ensure the demo targets the canary variant, not the global release, so attendees see the new batching improvements. Sam, can you pin a stable variant for the demo?

Sam (eng): Yep. Will pin variant `optimize-v2-demo` to the demo endpoint and add a routing rule. I'll also include a one-paragraph rollback in the changelog: how to flip to `optimize-v1`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1602 .

Priya (prod-marketing): Need the benchmark nuggets for the post: percentage latency improvement at 4k context and token cost delta. Who can confirm numbers?

Sam (eng): Quick numbers: 4k context median p95 down ~40%, end-to-end token unit cost down ~30% with new defaults. I'll add a summarized blurb to the changelog and paste raw benchmark links.

Marta (mktg): Great. Also set alerting: page #eng-oncall if error rate > 0.8% during the canary/promotion window. Is that reasonable?

Sam (eng): Yes. I'll create the alert rule and add it to the rollout notes.

deploy-bot: Dry-run canary scheduled by Sam at 2026-03-25T09:30:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Sam (eng): Dry-run canary live (5% -> optimize-v2-demo). Health checks OK, small increase in tail latency for one worker but within threshold. Tagging @Jamal for demo routing.

Emily (docs): Uploaded Console screenshot, updated quickstart, and added the rollback FAQ. Final docs URL: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2?final=1 . I also added redirect from /optimize -> release page.

Marta (mktg): Thanks Emily. Priya, I'll send the draft launch post once I swap in the final doc link.

Jamal (pm): Demo endpoint set to the pinned variant: https://api.redwood.ai/demo/optimize-v2 . Webinar updated with the benchmark bullets.

Sam (eng): Canary stable after 20m. Proceeding with staged promotion: 25% at 10:50 PT, 60% at 11:20 PT, 100% at 12:05 PT if no red flags. Rollback command included in the changelog: `rwi rollback --release optimize-v2`.

Priya (prod-marketing): I'll queue the social and blog scheduling for 12:15 PT. Please flag if you want to delay.

Marta (mktg): We'll aim for 12:15 PT publish. If ENG wants any throttle, say now. :eyes:

Sam (eng): Promotion to 25% complete, metrics look stable.

Priya (prod-marketing): Draft ready, swapped in final docs link. Need final benchmark sentence from Sam to finish hero line.

Sam (eng): Final benchmark line: "~40% median latency reduction at 4k context, ~30% token cost reduction with batching and quantization defaults." Use that.

Marta (mktg): Solid. We'll hit publish at 12:15 PT. Post-rollout checklist: update changelog with final notes, upload press kit assets, confirm redirects, and note alert history. I'll schedule a 30m retro tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Promotion schedule: 25% -> 2026-03-25T10:50:00-07:00, 60% -> 2026-03-25T11:20:00-07:00, 100% -> 2026-03-25T12:05:00-07:00.

Sam (eng): 60% promotion done at 11:21 PT, no errors.

Marta (mktg): Publishing now in 5. Minutes. Priya, keep an eye on inbound lead routing; we want canary leads routed to the demo ops queue.

Priya (prod-marketing): Confirmed. Leads from the demo API are routed to the demo-ops inbox and Sales SDRs will get the enriched lead list after 1 hour.

Sam (eng): 100% promotion complete at 12:06 PT. No elevated errors; latency improvements visible across regions.

Marta (mktg): Launch live. Thank you all. I'll file the retro notes and keep this thread for any follow-ups. :tada:
